text:
alex_support: MediCore (MC-7782) opened SUP-4921 — customer says audit logs for 2024-11 are missing in Console and they also asked for explicit HIPAA addendum language about KMS/HSM key provenance. Escalating to sec/legal/SRE. cc @maria_security @olivia_legal @jamie_sre

maria_security: quick clarifying q — are they on Private or Dedicated? that changes HSM model and what we can state.

alex_support: they're on Private (customer VPC + private control plane). customer attached an export that truncates at 2024-11-02, they claim full month is missing. ticket has screenshots.

jamie_sre: looking. initial logs show a retention policy change for org MC-7782 on 2024-12-01 (7y -> 30d). need to confirm who changed it before we assume data loss. run this internal query to see audit_changes: 
```
SELECT * FROM audit_changes WHERE org_id='MC-7782' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
```

nate_support: I reproduced the problem via API. call: `GET /v1/audit/logs?org=MC-7782&start=2024-11-01&end=2024-12-01` -> 500 with ShardNotFoundError. attaching stack snippet to the ticket.

olivia_legal: for the HIPAA addendum text we need a short statement on KMS/HSM handling (origin of key material, who holds plaintext, rotation guarantees). security, can you confirm exact phrasing we can share?

maria_security: high level: for Private we accept customer-supplied CMEK via their cloud KMS (HSM-backed). control plane never has plaintext keys. for on-prem HSM we support PKCS#11 integration and keys never leave the HSM. I'll draft exact language and include key rotation audit entries.

alex_support: customer also wants an export of the missing audit trail for 2024-11. can SRE start an ad-hoc export and give ETA? I'll tell customer 48-72h provisional.

jamie_sre: starting an extraction attempt for the missing shard now: `internal-log-export --org MC-7782 --range 2024-11-01:2024-12-01 --dest s3://redwood-support-exports/MC-7782/` If shard is expired we'll try cold backup restore (24-72h). will update SUP-4921.

devops-bot: Export job queued (job_id=98765) — requested by jamie_sre.

alex_support: noted. also flag: if we need to hand over logs to customer/legal we should confirm BAA status and whether a signed addendum is required for extra exports.

olivia_legal: they executed our standard BAA in 2023. for additional KMS/HSM wording we can issue an addendum (no new commercial DPA needed) — I'll prepare a one-page addendum and send for review.

jamie_sre: job started. if cold restore required I'll need ops approval to mount backup onto support restore cluster — may add an extra 24h.

nate_support: adding repro steps to the ticket: 1) call /v1/audit/logs with range 2) observe 500 / ShardNotFoundError 3) include `x-org-id: MC-7782` header 4) attach support trace id. attaching sample curl and stack.

maria_security: I'll pull key rotation provenance and KMS audit logs for MC-7782 and include canonical wording about "customer-managed CMEK, HSM-backed key material; control plane never has key plaintext". also will check who changed retention policy (audit_changes).

alex_support: thanks everyone. I'll update customer with ETA 72h and propose a call tomorrow 08:00 PT to review. SUP-4921 — adding meeting invite and thread link. :thumbsup:
